question: Who among the following personalities is an exponent of Indian classical dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rani Karnaa.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Rani Karnaa**, an exponent Indian classical dancer who gained recognition for her proficiency in the **kathak dance **technique, is regarded by many as one of the finest practitioners of the genre.
 
• She was awarded the **Padma Shri** by the Indian government in **2014** in recognition of her services to the dancing community.
 
• She is credited with **fusing** the **customs of the Jaipur and Lucknow gharanas** in addition to spreading kathak through her performances.
 
• In **1996**, she also received the** Sangeet Natak Akademi Award.**
